paper_metadata.title: High Mechanical Strengths of Mg-Ni-Y and Mg-Cu-Y Amorphous Alloys with Significant Supercooled Liquid Region

evidence.quote: Mg-Ni-Y and Mg-Cu-Y alloys were found to form an amorphous solid in wide compositional ranges of 0 to 40 at%Ni or Cu and 0 to 40%Y by the melt spinning technique.
Mg-Ni-Y and Mg-Cu-Y alloys were found to form an amorphous solid in wide compositional ranges of 0 to 40 at%Ni or Cu and 0 to 40%Y by the melt spinning technique.
Furthermore, it is notable that an amorphous phase is formed even in the Mg-Y binary system.

At any event, it is notable that the Mg-rich MgsoNi15Y5 and Mg85Cu5Y10 amorphous alloys exhibit high mechanical strengths of 830 and 800 MPa, respectively, for Of and 224 and 205, respectively, for Hv

other.charge: mixture of pure Mg (99.99 mass%) metal and Ni-Y alloy

evidence.quote: The Mg-based binary and ternary alloy ingots were prepared by induction-melting a mixture of pure Mg (99.99 mass%) metal and Ni-Y alloy in a purified argon atmosphere.
From the master alloy ingots, ribbons with a rectangular cross section of about 0.02 mm x 1 mm were prepared by a single roller melt-spinning technique in an argon atmosphere.
The amorphous nature of the melt-spun ribbons was examined by X-ray diffractometry and transmisSion electron microscopy (TEM) techniques.
the equilibrium structure was identified to consist of mixed phases of Mg2Ni, Mg2Y and Ni3Y for the former alloy
